data.title: Naya at District One
data.about:
Naya at District One (D1), Dubai, is the latest phase  of the luxury residences by Nakheel nestled within the vibrant MBR City. The project features an impressive collection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and lagoon villas. Each bespoke residential tower at Naya boasts an elegant lobby adorned with sophisticated furnishings, lofty ceilings, and 24/7 monitored security for a safe and welcoming environment.

Designed with elegance and surrounded by lush greenery, these bespoke homes offer some of the most breathtaking views in District One, overlooking the pristine Crystal Lagoon and Dubai's iconic skyline. The lagoon-facing apartments and villas set a new standard of luxury, providing unparalleled views of District One’s dazzling Crystal Lagoon and the stunning Dubai skyline.

characteristics_module.title: Naya at District One Apartments for Sale by Meydan Group
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Waterfront Living – Nestled within Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, offering direct access to a 1.5 km crystal lagoon, pristine beaches, and lush landscapes.
  • Unparalleled Location – Just 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai, with easy access to Meydan Racecourse, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport.
  • Architectural Excellence – Stunning 1 to 4-bedroom residences, penthouses, and lagoon villas, designed with floor-to-ceiling windows and seamless indoor-outdoor living.
  • Resort-Style Amenities – Residents enjoy infinity pools, shaded kids’ pools, a fitness center, padel courts, cycling and running tracks, and private cabanas.
  • Vibrant Lifestyle Hub – Features a multipurpose room, amphitheater, shaded dining areas, outdoor fitness zones, and kids’ play areas, fostering a strong sense of community.
  • Luxury & Privacy – A gated community that offers a perfect blend of seclusion and connectivity, ensuring an exclusive yet well-connected living experience.
  • Developer Excellence – Developed by Nakheel, a globally recognized master developer known for delivering award-winning, high-quality communities.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Strategically positioned in the heart of Dubai, Naya at District One boasts unparalleled connectivity and proximity to the city's iconic landmarks, offering residents convenience coupled with luxury.

  • Downtown Dubai – 10 minutes
  • Burj Khalifa – 10 minutes
  • Dubai Mall – 10 minutes
  • Business Bay – 10 minutes
  • Meydan Racecourse – 2 minutes
  • The Meydan Hotel – 2 minutes
  • Dubai Design District (D3) – 15 minutes

more_info.answer:
The starting prices for apartments vary based on size and type:
1-Bedroom – From AED 1.8M
2-Bedroom – From AED 2.7M
3-Bedroom – From AED 4.5M
4-Bedroom – From AED 7.6M
Lagoon Villas – From AED 8.9M
more_info.question: What are the starting prices of apartments at District One Naya Residences?

more_info.answer:
The project offers a flexible payment plan, with installments spread across the construction period:
20% on booking
10% in May 2026
10% in October 2026
5% in March 2027
5% in July 2027
35% upon completion in December 2028
